meta.source: florr_clone cpp/server/systems/{loot,petals,combat}.cpp + bot_ai.cpp + wasm反汇编 + 官方changelog字符串
meta.note: 第三方官方风格复刻源码, 参数与官方florr.io可能有差异, 作参考

loot.magnetism_behavior: 磁铁只扩大拾取半径, 不把掉落物吸过来(官方注释: 'Magnetism widens the reach and nothing else')
loot.drop_claim: 掉落物按伤害榜归owner, 死亡后回来仍可捡自己的那份(可捡一次)
loot.drop_rarity_roll: rollDropRarity(authored, mobRarity) = scale + finish 两级: 怪稀有度会抬升掉落稀有度

petals_heal.starfish_threshold: 血量 < 75 绝对数值触发(不是百分比! 源码注释: 'Starfish compares ABSOLUTE health, not a fraction')
petals_heal.starfish_amount: 回 25 x sqrt(3)^稀有度 x 天赋 x 3
petals_heal.healing_interval: 回血花瓣每 2000ms 触发一次
petals_heal.healing_amount: 回 20 x sqrt(3)^稀有度 x 天赋 x 3
petals_heal.blood_leaf: 爆炸 + 自伤-1(不致死, 保底1血)
petals_heal.heal_formula: amount x pow(sqrt(3), rarityIndex) x Healing天赋 x 3.0

combat.knockback_formula: impulse = direction x (strength / mass)  击退=花瓣击退值/怪质量, 替换旧向量不叠加
combat.knockback_implication: 质量大的怪(甲虫/沙暴类)几乎不吃击退 -> 打不动怪的第二信号
combat.mob_contact_knockback: 怪撞玩家固定小位移(玩家被打会被推)

boss_spawn.super_origin: difficulty-200的刷怪带全出Super(地图作者设定难度)
boss_spawn.unique_upgrade: Super出生时若biome的unique/apex时钟冷却完则抽rollBossUpgrade升级为Unique/Apex
boss_spawn.super_press: Super在场占着该biome的Unique/Apex名额 -> 抢Super=抢Unique入场券
boss_spawn.spawn_stagger: 各biome Boss错峰出生(避免同时), 相位随机

mob_ai_params.stinger_wind: 摆尾: 先摆到一侧蓄力, 保持250ms才齐射; 容差0.3rad(17度); 侧向死区0.15rad内不换侧
mob_ai_params.stinger_dodge: 闪避窗口 = 摆尾保持期250ms: 看到开摆立刻横移(保持横移方向), 250ms内拉开可躲
mob_ai_params.lod: 远怪(>kMobActiveRadius)思考频率1/5 -> 远处怪反应迟钝, 可先手偷袭
mob_ai_params.lod_boss_exception: Boss任何距离全速思考 -> 别指望偷袭Boss
mob_ai_params.pet_view: 宠物视野=主人屏幕矩形(视口一半)

movement_physics.mob_web_slow: 怪的web: 重叠时 speed_ratio=0.5(玩家减速50%)
movement_physics.petal_web_noslow: 花的Web花瓣不减速自己(源码: flower standing in Web field keeps full speed)
movement_physics.knockback_positional: 玩家被击退=位置性位移(不改变速度向量)

hornet_missile.note: 黄蜂导弹: 射程333, 打带跑安全线=撤出333

mantis_peas.note: 螳螂豌豆三连发: 射程500, 输出窗对齐300ms间隔

aggro_mechanics.player_notice_circle: 每玩家有独立被感知圈: gap <= range*scale + bonus; poo大便缩小感知圈(防围殴), 天赋/道具可加减
aggro_mechanics.los_block: 怪只追看得见的玩家(terrain.segmentBlocked射线检测) -> 绕障碍物(墙/树/地形)可甩怪! 躲猫猫逃跑
aggro_mechanics.nearest_first: 多候选取最近+视线可见第一个(不是最大贡献者)
aggro_mechanics.ledger_bounty: 谁打怪谁上账本, 怪追最近贡献者
aggro_mechanics.provocation_any_distance: 任何距离打怪都会引仇恨(远处打=怪从远处来追你)
aggro_mechanics.retention: 保留仇恨=flat 5视野(不看怪自身范围) - 逃跑要跑出5视野

aggro_constants.neutral_vs_hostile: Neutral只追打过它的(墙后/5视野外打=立刻失仇); Hostile只在自己范围内找目标(远处挑衅无效)
aggro_constants.player_over_pet: 玩家在场怪优先追玩家; 玩家出范围才追召唤物(召唤物可挡仇恨)
aggro_constants.size_ladder_range: 仇恨范围按身体中心量, 怪越大范围越大(super wasp 3355对436)
aggro_constants.bee_ai_always: 蜜蜂类怪横穿飞行(不直线冲), heading摆动

collision_mechanics.mob_hitbox: 各怪基础radius x 稀有度尺寸乘数(florr_clone mobs.json已存)
collision_mechanics.recoil_off_flower: 怪碰花被弹回: velocity -= dir * 560/(1 + mass), mass=1+radius/25 -> 小怪弹飞400速, super wasp(r436)只弹30速几乎不动
collision_mechanics.one_bump_per_tick: 玩家被围殴每tick只吃1次碰撞伤害(不会瞬间满伤)
collision_mechanics.glitch_infect: glitch怪碰玩家=感染glitched标记, 重生才清(尸体也glitched)
collision_mechanics.poison_shared_chain: 毒滴到共享链(长条怪)作用于整个身体池

spawn_mechanics.boss_deal_scatter: 多biome Boss均匀错开(洗牌+slot均匀分布), 不同时到
spawn_mechanics.boss_upgrade_rule: 时钟READY + biome无同tier在场(topBossTaken) + 10%概率 -> Super升级Unique/Apex; 升级成功时钟重置; Apex优先于Unique判定; 正常生成=Super
spawn_mechanics.same_tier_single: 同一biome同一tier同时只站一只Boss(在场期间不再抽同tier)

wasm_ai_behaviors.aggro_tiers: aggressive/semi-aggressive/passive 三档; 被打不回去的实体(墙后/地下)攻击时会逃跑(flee)
wasm_ai_behaviors.aggro_vs_attack_range: 两独立半径: 进aggro范围才追, 进attack范围才出手(hornet不会半张图开打)
wasm_ai_behaviors.aggro_grows_with_age: 仇恨范围随存活时间持续增长 - 越老的怪越容易引到你, 清旧怪优先
wasm_ai_behaviors.wave_end_all_aggro: 波末全体怪仇恨(已接入wave_end_count)
wasm_ai_behaviors.velocity_damping: -1.34%/帧 速度阻尼, 无推力0.5s内停下
wasm_ai_behaviors.contact_damage_base: 1.4 碰撞伤害 / 0.5 击退基准
wasm_ai_behaviors.rarity_scale: 1.15(hp/速度) / 1.38(伤害) / 1.1 随稀有度缩放
wasm_ai_behaviors.bulb_taunt: bulb灯泡=嘲讽拉怪道具; MobAggroRange花瓣可降低怪物对自己仇恨百分比
wasm_ai_behaviors.summon_collision: 召唤物不与其他召唤物碰撞; 对非友方怪造成碰撞伤害
wasm_ai_behaviors.missile_has_hp: 导弹是独立HP实体(missile health按花瓣health缩放) - 导弹可被击落
wasm_ai_behaviors.sandstorm_phase: 沙暴可穿透非玩家实体(仍造成伤害)
wasm_ai_behaviors.leech_shared_hp: leech节段共享HP(整个身体池一条命)
wasm_ai_behaviors.cactus_no_poison: cactus高稀有度不再带毒, 改加HP
wasm_ai_behaviors.beetle_special_move: beetle移动模型与普通怪不同

official_changelog_mechanics.loot_share_4p: 掉落分给伤害前4玩家(各需≥5%伤害, 小队伤害合并); 仅约屏幕距离内玩家可分到; 每玩家独立随机roll
official_changelog_mechanics.mob_drop_rarity_cap: 怪最多掉自身稀有度(旧版) -> 最多+1级(新版)
official_changelog_mechanics.luck_affects_spawn: Luck天赋影响刷怪稀有度(该区域怪稀有度提升)
official_changelog_mechanics.map_scales_with_mobs: 地图随包含怪缩放(防后期波次拥挤)
official_changelog_mechanics.wave_next_condition: 本波<=4只怪存活时下一波开始(已接入wave_end_count)
official_changelog_mechanics.pvp_drop_basic: PvP击杀玩家掉Basic花瓣(按对方点数)
official_changelog_mechanics.death_clears_credit: 死亡清伤害记录(复活除外)(已接入)
official_changelog_mechanics.salt_stack: Salt盐可叠加; 反射伤害对花减75%
official_changelog_mechanics.slow_rework: 减速效果按怪vs花瓣稀有度决定
official_changelog_mechanics.special_wave_15pct: 特殊单怪波不再固定波次, 任意波随机出现, 概率15%
official_changelog_mechanics.super_announce_region: Super出生公告发给区域内所有图所有玩家(super_ping已用)
official_changelog_mechanics.super_spawn_bias: Super偏向Ultra不常被杀的怪种生成; 不再随Ultra存活时间增加概率
official_changelog_mechanics.petal_offense_defense: 花瓣分进攻/防御型, 伤害与耐久缩放不同

spawn_announcement.ultra_spawn_10x: Ultra生成频率约10倍于从前, 但掉率低3-4倍 - 蹲Ultra掉落性价比下降
spawn_announcement.super_bias_rare_killed: Super偏向Ultra不常被杀的怪种生成
spawn_announcement.announce_here_vs_somewhere: 公告分"has spawned here!"(本地)与"has spawned somewhere!"(别处)
spawn_announcement.sacrifice_announce: 玩家sacrifice召唤的怪也发公告("has been summoned!") - 会被误报为Super, 需区分
spawn_announcement.special_wave_15pct: 特殊单怪波任意波15%概率
